title: Elixir of Guileful Movement

sources.title: Freedom of Movement (condition)
markers: * The affected creature's [[Movement Speed]] cannot be reduced by {{Condition type|Difficult Terrain}}, spells or magical effects.

summary: Until Long Rest, difficult terrain, spells, and other magical effects cannot reduce your movement speed, and you cannot be Paralysed or Restrained.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Until Long Rest, difficult terrain, spells, and other magical effects cannot reduce your movement speed, and you cannot be Paralysed or Restrained.
fields.Stacking: Replaces other normal elixirs and can be overwritten by another.
fields.Crafting: Combine Suspension of Ochre Jelly with any Sublimate.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Verified card mechanics against the cited item or linked rule.
